words.example: On their first morning, new staff sit down and read the code of conduct.
words.exampleZh: 新员工第一个上午要坐下来阅读行为规范。

words.example: Score no bids until each of you has declared any conflict of interest.
words.exampleZh: 在各位都申报了利益冲突之前，先不要给标书打分。

words.example: Sign the declaration before you walk into the bid review meeting.
words.exampleZh: 进入评标会之前，请先签署申报声明。

words.example: Leaving the department does not end your duty of confidentiality.
words.exampleZh: 离开本部门并不会终止你的保密义务。

words.example: They signed the non-disclosure and only then saw the system demo.
words.exampleZh: 他们先签了保密约定，然后才看了系统演示。

words.meaning: 系统中心配置管理（System Center Configuration Manager）
words.example: SCCM (System Center Configuration Manager) is pushing the viewer to every reading room PC.
words.exampleZh: SCCM（系统中心配置管理）正在把阅片软件推到每台读片室电脑。

words.example: Intune enrolled the new ward tablets and applied the hospital Wi-Fi profile.
words.exampleZh: Intune 注册了新的病区平板，并套上了医院的 Wi-Fi 配置。

words.meaning: 移动设备管理（Mobile Device Management）
words.example: MDM (Mobile Device Management) can wipe a lost tablet without touching the SIM.
words.exampleZh: MDM（移动设备管理）可以清空丢失的平板，不用动 SIM 卡。

words.meaning: 自带设备（Bring Your Own Device）
words.example: BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) phones stay off the medical-record VLAN.
words.exampleZh: BYOD（自带设备）的手机不能进入病历 VLAN。

words.example: Each mobile device on the ward must check in before it can open mail.
words.exampleZh: 病区每台移动设备都要先登记，才能打开邮件。
